title: 🌅 Day 1 Official Kickoff: Focus on IBPS RRB PO Sprint & Foundation
summary: Clean slate active. The countdown to 20 Nov 2026 starts today with clear priorities: IBPS RRB PO Officer Scale I (Priority 1) with UPSC APFC and RAS in supporting alignment.
commentary:
Welcome to Day 1 of your renewed sprint. We eliminated all distractions and clashing IIBF DBF noise so your cognitive energy is 100% focused on your high-leverage targets: IBPS RRB PO Officer Scale I (Primary Priority, target 20 Nov 2026), UPSC APFC (Strategic Priority 2), and RAS Preliminary (Priority 3).

In bank prelims examinations, speed is merely a derivative of decision-making clarity. A candidate who scores 56+ does not work twice as fast; they decide twice as fast whether a question is a 30-second free mark or a 2-minute trap.

Your mandate today: Begin with a full-length diagnostic mock drill. When you post your score, this coaching engine will automatically deconstruct your accuracy, negative mark leakage, and time allocation so you never practice blindly.

actionItems.title: Take 1 full-length IBPS RRB PO Prelims mock drill (45 minutes, 80 questions)
Log attempt and dedicated post-test analysis time directly into the tracker
Maintain absolute 90%+ accuracy discipline: zero negative marks on random guesses

socraticQuestion: What single habit or friction point caused you the most fatigue in past cycles, and what boundary will you set today to eliminate it?
